title: Lior and the Kitchen
author: Kestrel Iversen
blurb: Rosalind Crane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
